aboutMcp.title: What is MCP?
aboutMcp.desc: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a universal standard that enables any AI to directly control external services — manage data, create documents, send messages, analyze files, and automate workflows in a single command, without writing a single line of code.
aboutMcp.examplesLabel: One AI command does it all
aboutMcp.example1: "Pull sales from Google Sheet, create a summary report in Notion, and send a notification to the team via LINE"
aboutMcp.example2: "Collect customer feedback from Gmail, analyze sentiment, and auto-update the CRM"
aboutMcp.example3: "Create an invoice from WooCommerce, convert to PDF, and send to the customer via Telegram"

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How is MCP different from API?
faq.a1: MCP is a standard designed for AI to understand and use directly, without writing integration code. Unlike APIs that require individual integration for each service.
faq.a2: Very easy! Just sign up, get your URL, and paste it into Claude. No technical knowledge required.
faq.a3: Start for free! We have Pro plans for those who need more usage.
faq.a4: Any AI client that supports MCP — Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and more. Just paste the URL and you're ready to go.
faq.q5: Do I need my own server?
faq.a5: No! We handle all the infrastructure for you. Just sign up and start using it right away.
faq.a6: Yes. All connections are encrypted, and we do not store your personal data.

about.title: Node2Flow
about.subtitle: MCP Server Platform that connects your AI to any service
about.aboutDesc1: Node2Flow is a platform that provides ready-to-use MCP (Model Context Protocol) Servers, enabling any AI — whether Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Cursor — to directly command external services without writing code or installing anything.
about.aboutDesc2: We believe AI should be accessible to everyone. You don't need to be a programmer to use AI for real work. Node2Flow helps you connect AI with Notion, Google Sheets, LINE, Slack, WooCommerce, and many more services with MCP Servers that are ready to use instantly.
about.missionEasyDesc: Making MCP accessible to everyone. No technical knowledge needed. Sign up and start using it.
about.missionSafeDesc: Data encrypted at every step. Supports Application Password. No main password stored.
about.missionReadyDesc: Pre-deployed MCP Server. No installation needed. No server required.
about.whatWeDoDesc: We provide comprehensive MCP services — from ready-to-use MCP Server Hub, pre-built Workflow Automation, custom MCP Server development, MCP Server hosting for those without their own server, and installation services for customers who need help with setup.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1: We collect only the information necessary to provide our services, including: name, email, profile picture (from Google OAuth), order information, and MCP Server usage data.
privacy.s2: We use your information to: provide MCP Server services, manage user accounts, process orders, send service updates, and improve our services.
privacy.s3: We implement appropriate security measures including: data encryption (HTTPS), encrypted password storage, Application Password usage instead of main passwords, and data access restrictions.
privacy.s4: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties, except when necessary to provide our services (e.g., Stripe for payment processing).
privacy.s5: We only use cookies necessary for system functionality, such as Session Cookies for login. We do not use cookies for tracking or advertising.
privacy.s6: You have the right to: view your data, request corrections, request account and data deletion, and withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at node2flow@gmail.com.
privacy.s7: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be announced on this page. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.
privacy.s8: If you have questions about our privacy policy, contact:

product.whatIsDesc2: Instead of copy-pasting JSON or manually creating workflows, just tell AI what you need. AI will create the workflow, install it in n8n, and activate it automatically.
